listening.title: Buổi standup buổi sáng của đội dev

lines.speaker: Nam (Scrum Master)
lines.text: Morning, Trang. Let's run the standup quickly since the client call starts soon.

lines.speaker: Trang (Developer)
lines.text: Sounds good. Yesterday I updated the login page, and I have no blockers today.

lines.speaker: Nam (Scrum Master)
lines.text: Nice. Can you share an update on the API bug you were fixing?

lines.speaker: Trang (Developer)
lines.text: Sure, I'll get straight to the point — it's almost fixed, just need one more test.

lines.speaker: Nam (Scrum Master)
lines.text: Great. Let's check the task board to see what's still open.

lines.speaker: Trang (Developer)
lines.text: I see my ticket there. I'll mark as done once QA approves it this afternoon.

lines.speaker: Nam (Scrum Master)
lines.text: Perfect. Do you also give a day-to-day update to the client?

lines.speaker: Trang (Developer)
lines.text: Not directly, but our team posts an async standup on Slack every morning for them.

lines.speaker: Nam (Scrum Master)
lines.text: That's smart since some of them work in a different time zone.

lines.speaker: Trang (Developer)
lines.text: Exactly. It keeps everyone informed without needing another meeting.
